title: Add video captions and titles when requested.
summary: Deliver generated video directly, then use optional text postproduction when captions or overlays are needed.
highlights: Keep the raw video and deliver its actual model, prompt, reference roles and run details without automatic analysis.
Use an explicit timed text plan for captions, static overlays and simple fades; retain the plan and original for later changes.
Record observable on-screen text timing, placement and styling during video analysis without guessing font names.
